title: Admin user-search endpoint has no authentication or authorization check
description: GET /api/admin/users/search is served unauthenticated to any caller, returning PII (email, username, id). No HttpSession check, role check, @ServletSecurity, or web.xml filter. /api/admin/ path asserts privilege boundary that code does not enforce.

title: Database credentials hardcoded in source
description: DB password embedded as string literal in DriverManager.getConnection. Lands in version control, compiled .class bytes, and is readable to anyone with repo or JAR access. Rotating requires code change and redeploy.

title: LIKE wildcards in user input are not escaped, allowing full-table enumeration
description: Pattern string correctly parameterized but raw input interpolated into pattern via string concatenation. username=% produces LIKE '%%%' matching every row; unbounded result set with no LIMIT.

title: Database failures are swallowed with no logging
description: Broad Exception catch discards errors and returns generic 500. Query failures in production reach no logs, making outages undiagnosable. Also absorbs unexpected RuntimeExceptions from gson/servlet code.
